name: R16 M4 Guardian Staff: Fate Guarder

system.description:
[Trigger: Setup] All allies within 20Sq of you receive a +1D instead of +2 to "Defense Checks when in Hate" for the duration of this effect, which lasts until the end of the round. Once per scenario. A staff that binds the power of moonlight and blowing wind with strong threads, sealing it within. It is said to provide moonlight to those lost in the night and a following wind to those confused by calm. When the password is spoken and the sealed knot is undone, a luminous white mist fills the surroundings, granting the "Power to Resist Adversity." Many large guilds carry it as a talisman.

Strong Core Material (500G) + Cypress Staff (850G) + Stealth Scroll (Intermediate) (460G) + [Magic Catalyst 16] (250G) ×2 + Crafting Cost (690G)
